findings.highlight: [blank page]
findings.evidenceJa: それは、星を祭る祭壇だった。
findings.governingReading: The underground site is introduced as an altar that worships the stars.
findings.explanation: mirror moon leaves the entire active opening page blank, removing the image that governs the inverted rite.

findings.highlight: the wind’s stagnant
findings.evidenceJa: 風は封殺され
findings.governingReading: The wind has been sealed off and killed.
findings.explanation: “Stagnant” describes still air but removes the deliberate violent suppression.

findings.highlight: the drops of water on the walls are colored like poison
findings.evidenceJa: 壁に滲む水滴は悉くが毒の色
findings.governingReading: Every drop of water seeping through the wall is the color of poison.
findings.explanation: The English drops both seepage and the exhaustive force of every single drop.

findings.highlight: No human would come here.
findings.evidenceJa: ここを訪れるモノはみな人ではない。
findings.governingReading: All beings that visit this place are nonhuman.
findings.explanation: The English changes a categorical account of actual visitors into a hypothetical statement about human willingness.

findings.highlight: The only ones to come and honor this alien world are serpents fleeing from the light.
findings.evidenceJa: このような異界に救いを求め、このような異景を祭ろうとするモノは、陽の光から逃れる蛇蠍魔蠍の類
findings.governingReading: Those who seek salvation in and worship this alien scene must be creatures such as snakes and scorpions fleeing sunlight.
findings.explanation: The English removes seeking salvation and the scorpion half of the reviled creature catalogue.

findings.highlight: the one who lost his Master, the Servant Assassin
findings.evidenceJa: 言峰綺礼によって主を失ったサーヴァント・アサシン
findings.governingReading: This is Assassin, the Servant deprived of his Master by Kirei Kotomine.
findings.explanation: The English removes Kirei as the cause of the Master’s loss.

findings.highlight: He stops five meters in front of the girl.
findings.evidenceJa: 少女から離れること三間。
findings.governingReading: Assassin remains three ken, approximately 5.45 meters, away from Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English changes the measured traditional distance and adds that he stops directly in front of her.

findings.highlight: And the call reaches him.
findings.evidenceJa: 果たして、呼びかけは応えられた。
findings.governingReading: Assassin’s call is duly answered.
findings.explanation: The English reverses the response relation, making the call reach Assassin rather than Zouken answer it.

findings.highlight: The old man who was killed by Kotomine Kirei
findings.evidenceJa: 言峰綺礼に退治された筈の老人
findings.governingReading: The old man supposedly exterminated or disposed of by Kirei is nevertheless active underground.
findings.explanation: The English states literal death, blurring the reveal that Kirei destroyed only one manifestation.

findings.highlight: sleeping in the safest place on earth
findings.evidenceJa: 最も安全な場所で眠っている
findings.governingReading: The soul-anchor sleeps in the safest available place.
findings.explanation: The English adds “on earth,” turning a relative security judgment into a global superlative.

findings.highlight: unless the main body is destroyed
findings.evidenceJa: 本体である虫を潰さねば
findings.governingReading: Zouken cannot perish unless the worm that is his true body is crushed.
findings.explanation: The English retains the main body but removes that it is specifically a worm and that it must be crushed.

findings.highlight: having my limbs destroyed
findings.evidenceJa: 手足どもを潰された
findings.governingReading: Zouken calls the destroyed external worm bodies his hands and feet or operative proxies.
findings.explanation: The English presents literal bodily limbs and obscures his distributed parasitic embodiment.

findings.highlight: go find a new body above ground
findings.evidenceJa: 地上で新しい肉を調達する
findings.governingReading: Zouken would have to procure new flesh above ground.
findings.explanation: The English sanitizes the predatory procurement of flesh into finding a body.

findings.highlight: now that Berserker is defeated
findings.evidenceJa: バーサーカーを失った今
findings.governingReading: Now that Sakura has lost Berserker, Zouken says she needs another guard.
findings.explanation: The English changes loss of possession into battlefield defeat.

findings.highlight: the one who has absolute control over her
findings.evidenceJa: 絶対者である老人
findings.governingReading: Sakura ignores the old man presented as the absolute ruler in their hierarchy.
findings.explanation: The English promotes the broader hierarchical title into an explicit claim of absolute control over Sakura at this moment.

findings.highlight: Are you disobeying me?
findings.evidenceJa: ワシの言葉が聞けぬというのか
findings.governingReading: Zouken initially asks whether Sakura cannot hear his words.
findings.explanation: The English prematurely resolves silence as deliberate disobedience, before the characters consider mental collapse.

findings.highlight: she lost Illyasviel and Berserker
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤスフィールを逃し、バーサーカーを失った少女の不手際
findings.governingReading: Zouken is angry at Sakura’s inept handling that let Illya escape and cost Berserker.
findings.explanation: The English lists losses but removes Sakura’s operational failure and the escape causality.

findings.highlight: She has such a great power within her
findings.evidenceJa: あれほどの念を受け入れている
findings.governingReading: Assassin says Sakura has received or contained an overwhelming mass of thought, will, or accumulated psychic force.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the mental burden used to infer her collapse to generic power.

findings.highlight: a weak girl
findings.evidenceJa: 脆弱な小娘
findings.governingReading: Assassin contemptuously calls Sakura a frail little girl.
findings.explanation: The English removes the belittling age and register of his diagnosis.

findings.highlight: sounds disappointed, yet happy
findings.evidenceJa: 心底残念そうに、心底嬉しそうに
findings.governingReading: Zouken sounds from the bottom of his heart both disappointed and delighted.
findings.explanation: The English removes the repeated extremity that exposes both emotions as equally genuine.

findings.highlight: Her mind has been swallowed by darkness.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の意識は、とうに闇に呑まれている
findings.governingReading: The narration says Sakura’s consciousness has long since been swallowed by darkness.
findings.explanation: “Mind” broadens a locally reversible loss of consciousness into apparent destruction of her mental self.

findings.highlight: take over my empty granddaughter
findings.evidenceJa: 空洞になった孫娘を食らおう
findings.governingReading: Zouken euphemistically claims necessity while proposing to devour his supposedly hollow granddaughter.
findings.explanation: “Take over” preserves possession but removes the predatory consumption in his own language.

findings.highlight: Rising from her throat… is the old man’s laughter.
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐桜の声帯を使って上げられる、老魔術師の笑い
findings.governingReading: Zouken produces his laugh by using empty Sakura’s vocal cords.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the throat location but removes the explicit instrumental use of her vocal anatomy.

findings.highlight: I wanted to give you the glory of obtaining the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: せめて聖杯を手に入れる栄光は譲りたかった
findings.governingReading: Zouken claims he at least wanted to yield or concede to Sakura the glory of obtaining the Grail.
findings.explanation: The English removes the concession relation by which the glory was supposedly his to yield.

findings.highlight: The ritual did not succeed in time
findings.evidenceJa: 儀式が間に合わなかった
findings.governingReading: The ritual failed to be ready or completed in time because Sakura let Illya escape.
findings.explanation: The English suggests an attempted ritual failed rather than that its preparation missed the necessary timing.

findings.highlight: It’s a distorted thought that creeps up from her heart.
findings.evidenceJa: 少女にとって逃れようのない、自身の心臓からにじり寄る、歪つな思念
findings.governingReading: The threat is an inescapable distorted will creeping from Sakura’s own heart rather than a visible external worm.
findings.explanation: The English removes that the internal approach is inescapable for Sakura.

findings.highlight: a false nerve hidden within Matou Sakura’s heart
findings.evidenceJa: 心臓に潜む擬似神経体
findings.governingReading: Zouken’s anchor is a pseudo-neural organism lurking in Sakura’s heart.
findings.explanation: “A false nerve” reduces a body-like neural organism serving as his soul anchor to one ordinary nerve.

findings.highlight: her body hasn’t changed yet
findings.evidenceJa: 体はまだ変わりきっていない
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s body has not yet completed its transformation.
findings.explanation: The English says it has not changed at all, erasing the ongoing transformation already visible.

findings.highlight: I shall now take your flesh as my own
findings.evidenceJa: 消えた理性に代わってワシが引き継いでやろう
findings.governingReading: Zouken says he will inherit the body in place of Sakura’s supposedly vanished reason.
findings.explanation: The English retains appropriation of flesh but removes his stated substitution for her lost rational self.

findings.highlight: You’ve endured more than I expected from an experiment.
findings.evidenceJa: 実験作の身でよくぞ耐え抜き
findings.governingReading: Zouken praises Sakura for enduring to the end despite being a prototype or experimental creation.
findings.explanation: The English invents comparison against his expectation and weakens her objectified status as the experimental body.

findings.highlight: You have done well to please me
findings.evidenceJa: よくぞワシを愉しませた
findings.governingReading: Zouken thanks Sakura for having entertained or amused him.
findings.explanation: “Please me” makes her service submissive and favorable rather than exposing his enjoyment of her ordeal.

findings.highlight: A sound of writhing blood vessels. Matou Zouken’s spirit
findings.evidenceJa: ずるずると血管を這う音がする。腐敗する間桐臓硯の霊体が
findings.governingReading: The sound is Zouken’s decaying spiritual body dragging itself through blood vessels.
findings.explanation: The English makes the blood vessels themselves writhe and disconnects the sound from Zouken’s movement.

findings.highlight: The girl puts her hand on her chest and wakes up.
findings.evidenceJa: 少女は目を覚ましていた
findings.governingReading: With her own hand against her chest, the girl is already awake.
findings.explanation: The English changes the revealed state into an awakening that occurs on this page.

findings.highlight: you still persist?
findings.evidenceJa: まだ踏み止まっておったか
findings.governingReading: Zouken realizes Sakura has still held her ground against being swallowed.
findings.explanation: “Persist” weakens the spatial-resistance image and the surprise that she stopped short of collapse.

findings.highlight: form a contract with him
findings.evidenceJa: ワシの代わりにアサシンと契約するがよい
findings.governingReading: Zouken orders Sakura to contract with Assassin in his place.
findings.explanation: The English removes that she is being commanded to replace Zouken as Assassin’s mana-supplying contractor.

findings.highlight: body is compressed in an instant
findings.evidenceJa: 一撃のもとに体を圧縮され
findings.governingReading: Assassin’s body is compressed by a single attack.
findings.explanation: The English retains speed but removes the one-blow force of Sakura’s action.

findings.highlight: Such a disappointment.
findings.evidenceJa: つまらない人だった
findings.governingReading: Sakura calls Assassin a dull or trivial person whose concealed absence of a face manufactures the impression of one.
findings.explanation: The English changes a contemptuous judgment of him into Sakura’s personal disappointment.

findings.highlight: The Holy Grail can’t go back into the past and regain your name.
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯でも、過去に戻って貴方の名前を取り戻すなんてコトはできない
findings.governingReading: Sakura claims even the Grail cannot go into the past and recover Assassin’s name for him.
findings.explanation: The English makes the Grail regain a name belonging to it, reversing the beneficiary and possessor.

findings.highlight: old man of the mountain
findings.evidenceJa: 山の主
findings.governingReading: Sakura addresses Assassin by the title “lord/master of the mountain.”
findings.explanation: The English changes the title into an age-marked “old man,” weakening his institutional identity.

findings.highlight: You can’t become the one and only Hassan.
findings.evidenceJa: ただ一人の本物になど成れない
findings.governingReading: Sakura says the nameless assassin can never become the sole genuine one.
findings.explanation: The English supplies “Hassan” as the withheld identity, resolving the object of authenticity inside Sakura’s taunt.

findings.highlight: His panic is akin to fury.
findings.evidenceJa: 老人の混乱は狂乱に近い。
findings.governingReading: Zouken’s confusion or panic is close to frenzy.
findings.explanation: “Fury” substitutes anger for destabilized near-madness.

findings.highlight: Is he surprised, or is he frightened?
findings.evidenceJa: 突然の凶行に驚いたのか、それとも何か、言いようの無い恐怖を感じたが故の狂乱か
findings.governingReading: The narration leaves open whether sudden violence shocked Zouken or an indescribable fear drove him toward frenzy.
findings.explanation: The English removes the violent trigger, indescribability, and causal link to his frantic state.

findings.highlight: we have to give him leave
findings.evidenceJa: 彼には暇をあげないと可哀想
findings.governingReading: Sakura says it would be pitiful not to dismiss Assassin now that Zouken no longer needs his protection.
findings.explanation: The English preserves leave but removes Sakura’s chillingly polite claim of pity.

findings.highlight: tore her nerves
findings.evidenceJa: 全身の神経がズタズタになりそうな行為
findings.governingReading: Her self-gouging act looks capable of shredding the nerves throughout her body.
findings.explanation: One displayed English branch promotes apparent catastrophic risk into already completed nerve destruction.

findings.highlight: her grandfather, what used to be her grandfather, what seems to have been her grandfather
findings.evidenceJa: 祖父であるモノ、祖父と名乗るモノ、祖父であったらしいモノ
findings.governingReading: Sakura observes the thing that is her grandfather, claims the name grandfather, and seems to have been her grandfather.
findings.explanation: The English removes the crucial middle category of an entity that merely calls itself her grandfather and changes the sequence’s temporal logic.

findings.highlight: when he planted himself in her heart
findings.evidenceJa: 少女の心臓に寄生する為
findings.governingReading: Zouken switched anchors so that he could parasitize Sakura’s heart.
findings.explanation: “Planted himself” removes the exploitative biological relation that explains his body choice.

findings.highlight: I would’ve been swallowed
findings.evidenceJa: 本当にわたしが食べられていた
findings.governingReading: Sakura says Zouken truly would have eaten her.
findings.explanation: The English weakens direct predatory consumption into ambiguous swallowing.

findings.highlight: she betrayed him
findings.evidenceJa: 老魔術師に反旗を翻す
findings.governingReading: Sakura raises the flag of rebellion against the old magus who had ruled her.
findings.explanation: “Betrayed” adopts the ruler’s loyalty frame and casts her resistance as personal treachery.

findings.highlight: I shall entrust you with the gate
findings.evidenceJa: 門は全ておまえに与える
findings.governingReading: Zouken claims he will give Sakura all of the Gate or every relevant gate.
findings.explanation: The English singularizes the scope of what he desperately offers.

findings.highlight: the trash in her fingers
findings.evidenceJa: 指先でつまんだ汚物
findings.governingReading: Sakura smiles gently at the filth she pinches between her fingertips.
findings.explanation: “Trash” loses the bodily revulsion of treating Zouken as excrement or contamination.

findings.highlight: the blood on her hand
findings.evidenceJa: 掌にこびりついた血
findings.governingReading: Sakura stares at blood caked or stuck to her palm.
findings.explanation: The English removes both the palm location and the clinging physical condition.

findings.highlight: like an empty puppet
findings.evidenceJa: 糸の切れた人形のような空虚さ
findings.governingReading: Her laughter has the emptiness of a puppet whose strings have been cut.
findings.explanation: The English keeps emptiness and puppet imagery but removes the severed strings that bind liberation to loss of control.

findings.highlight: laughs like an empty puppet
findings.evidenceJa: いつまでも笑い続けた
findings.governingReading: Sakura continues laughing without end or for an indefinite duration.
findings.explanation: The English removes the continuing, apparently endless duration of the final laugh.
